decisions.reason: This two-component resin injection unit remains close to the firm's established plural-component and injection knowledge, so it is more likely to be refined within the portfolio than withdrawn.
An automatic airless spray gun builds directly on the firm's core spray-application competences and service capabilities, giving management a strong basis to keep and incrementally improve it.
A manual airless spray gun sits at the center of the firm's long-standing product, manufacturing and customer-support knowledge, so continued commercialization is the likely choice.
Because this air-assisted airless spray gun is a multi-model line in one of the firm's main technology areas, the firm is likely to retain it and optimize it across applications rather than exit.

The data logger is complementary but less rooted in the firm's traditional mechanical absorptive base, so management is likely to reallocate resources if digital learning and commercial traction remain limited.
